name: tree-igdesign-dual-loop-veto
hypothesis: If both antibody-specialist models have HCDR3 scRMSD above 2 angstrom, tie their structurally inconsistent tail at zero; otherwise keep ABB2 ordering. Independent agreement on loop failure may be more reliable than globally averaging weak predictors. The single rounded 2 angstrom scale was chosen before evaluation, with no neighborhood search; its system dependence is a known risk.
